title: Drug Scope
tagline: Twenty-nine molecules, each with an FTIR and a Raman spectrum, drawn as a CRT oscilloscope screen.
method:
The molecule sits above and its spectrum below, both stroked onto a simulated scope face. Three additive buffers composite over a faint graticule: a decaying persistence buffer carrying the spectrum as a scope trace, a second holding the skeletal BONDS, and a third holding the functional-group SYMBOLS and all text. Each gets a half-resolution bloom and then the CRT film filter. Two methods run in sequence, FTIR then Raman, cross-dissolving through the phosphor at the midpoint, with the transition signalled by a one-second ASCII scramble of the lower text rather than a fade.

The two methods are genuinely different, which took work: the same band POSITIONS are reweighted by selection rules, since IR intensity goes with dipole change (C=O, C-O and S=O strong) while Raman goes with polarisability change (C=C, ring breathing and C-C skeletal strong). The Raman legend is the same diagnostic modes REORDERED by Raman strength.

output.note: The layout is driven by a handful of fractional y-coordinates on `DrugScope` (`sub1_y`, `sub2_y`, `header_bot`, `title_y`, `method_top`), so re-proportioning for a landscape frame is a matter of those numbers plus the molecule's `target_w_frac` — not of the drawing code.

modules.what: The catalogue itself. Per molecule: atom coordinates (2-D or 3-D), bonds, labels in role tokens, a fixed bounding box for stable scale, IR line positions and intensities, the diagnostic vibrational bands, titles and metadata. Raman lines and bands are synthesised at import by reweighting the IR set through the selection rules.
The screen. Three additive buffers, the power-on intro, the FTIR-to-Raman handover, the red line playhead, the symbol knockout, the text flare, and the 3-D projection with its two motion modes.
Render one molecule, or one frame chunk of one. `--preview` for a fast look, `--frames LO:HI --out seg` for a chunk.

The high-quality path. Splits every molecule into frame chunks and work-steals them across three GPU lanes, so idle lanes pick up the next chunk and the tail stays balanced, then concatenates per molecule. Seamless because each chunk warms the phosphor first and the film filter is absolute-frame indexed with a fixed seed.
The CRT persistence buffer and graticule — shared with the oscilloscope engine.
The film filter, here with a neutral white-phosphor config because the content is multi-coloured.
Decode and mux helpers. Unused by this format, which ships silent, but present because the render path shares them.

objects.intro: The parts that are reusable independently of which molecule is on screen.

items.name: DrugScope
items.what: The compositor. Owns the three buffers, the layout, and the timeline.

items.name: power-on intro
items.what: The screen flicks on, then an INVISIBLE vertical line sweeps left to right; only where it crosses an object is that slice lit into the phosphor, so the accelerating slice SMEARS through persistence into a solid line. The traces appear to speed up until solid.
items.notes: Alternatives are a gentler ramp and a single wipe. Setting the intro length to zero disables it; the handover leaves the phosphor already primed either way.

items.name: method handover
items.what: FTIR cross-dissolves to Raman through the phosphor, announced by a one-second ASCII scramble of all lower text.
items.notes: A scramble rather than a fade — a fade reads as an accident, a scramble reads as an instrument changing mode.

items.name: line playhead
items.what: A short bright red leading segment of the trace sweeps the curve with a phosphor comet-tail.
items.notes: A LINE, not a dot. A dot on a spectrum reads as a cursor; a lit leading segment reads as acquisition.

items.name: symbol knockout
items.what: Each functional-group symbol carries a glyph-sized knockout ellipse that clears BONDS ONLY — never the graticule — so letters never sit on a bond while the grid still shows through behind them.
items.notes: Symbols sit ON their atom. Pushing them further out moves N and O off their own bonds.

items.name: text flare
items.what: Subtitles and legend lines occasionally scramble a couple of glyphs and return, on a 1.8–3.6 s gap.
items.notes: Small enough to read as signal noise rather than as an effect.

items.name: billboard rock
items.what: A bounded left-right rotation, never edge-on, that reveals depth on a molecule with a big flat face.
items.notes: Global, the same for every molecule. A 3-D molecule 'moves badly' only when its geometry presents a small ring or non-flat face to the camera.

items.name: multi-axis tumble
items.what: Continuous rotation on three axes at incommensurate frequencies, plus a fixed in-plane spin.
items.notes: Scale and centre come from the SAMPLED tumble envelope — the union bounding box over 96 sampled rotations — so a tumbling molecule never clips or drifts.

items.name: principal-plane orientation
items.what: Orients by the whole-molecule principal plane, so the flattest face points at the camera and z-variance is minimised.
items.notes: The fix for anything that sprawls off its aromatic ring. The default aromatic-ring rule is right for scaffolds that HAVE a big flat ring.

items.name: IR-to-Raman reweighting
items.what: Same positions, different intensity envelope, by selection rule.
items.notes: Spectra are ILLUSTRATIVE — group-contribution positions with a heuristic Raman reweight, not measured or DFT. Positions are sound, relative intensities approximate, and only about 600–1900 cm-1 is shown. Do not cite them.

parameters_intro: Per-molecule tuning is a small dict; the rest is global.

parameters.name: target_w_frac
parameters.meaning: How wide the molecule draws as a fraction of the frame.
parameters.range: 0.62–0.74 for steroids, tripeptides and alkaloids; 0.82–0.88 for long fatty-acid chains

parameters.name: sym_px
parameters.range: Scaled to the molecule by default

parameters.name: motion
parameters.range: Only meaningful when the atom coordinates carry a z

parameters.name: plane_ring
parameters.meaning: `aromatic` keys orientation on the aromatic ring; `pca` on the whole-molecule principal plane.
parameters.range: Use `pca` for anything that sprawls off its ring

parameters.name: t_switch
parameters.range: duration/2, so it follows the clip length automatically

parameters.name: title_y / method_top / header_bot / sub1_y / sub2_y
parameters.meaning: The layout. The molecule zone is the gap between `header_bot` and `method_top`.
parameters.range: Both the normal and intro text paths read these — keep them in sync

parameters.name: breath
parameters.range: Keep it SMALL — plus or minus 0.5%. At 5% the curve bounced too much to read.
